title: Study of the decay K+ -> pi+ nu nubar in the momentum region 140 < P(pi) < 199 MeV/c
excerpt: Three new events consistent with K+ -> pi+ nu nubar from 1.71e12 stopped kaons, estimated background ~0.93 events; combined with prior observations, seven total events yield Br(K+ -> pi+ nu nubar) = (1.73+1.15-1.05) x 10^-10.
